chunks: ʿAlī ibn Saʿīd asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about salat al-layl and al-witr during travel at the beginning of the night.

key_terms.السَّفَرِ: travel, which affects certain prayer rulings
key_terms.الْوَتْرِ: the witr prayer performed as part of the night prayer

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat al-layl and witr early in the night while traveling?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning salat al-layl and al-witr while traveling. It indicates the permissibility of performing them at the beginning of the night during السفر.
